# TRACE 0.2 codes

A code is the typology letter, three digits and the corpus: -J Curia, -N Lex, -M Vox, no letter when the step is shared. Step typologies: S search, L model reading, R rule or processing, C check, O operation, N index; ingredients: D data, P probes, G codebook and maps, F brakes. A code is fixed forever: the version is written beside it (L110-J v1) and the position in the pipeline is kept in the registry. Numbers were assigned once, on 21/10/2026, in steps of ten; the free numbers in between are for new steps. Every code is always written with its name.
